newsitem.title: USA: Grow Biz buys Ohio video retailer.
newsitem.headline: Grow Biz buys Ohio video retailer.

text.p: Grow Biz International Inc said Friday it completed the acquisition of 40 retail stores, their inventory and franchising rights from Video Game Exchange based in Cleveland, Ohio.

These stores buy, sell and trade used video games and equipment. They operate in Ohio, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Georgia and Maryland. Video Game Exchange is privately held and has $17 million in annual revenues.
Terms of the transaction wtre not disclosed.
Grow Biz has said it plans to franchise 1,000 stores selling video games, computer games, comics, trading cards, Japan-a-mation videos, strategy books and games, and accessories nationwide.
Current Video Game Exchange stores will be converted to this broader format and all stores will operate under the title, 'It's About Games.'
Grow Biz its first pilot store yesterday in Minneapolis. Franchises for 'It's About Games' will be available throughout the United States and Canada shortly.
Grow Biz develops franchises and operates value- oriented retail concepts for stores that buy, sell, trade and consign used and new merchandise.
